PASSED IN MVC NO.414/2015, ON THE FILE OF THE ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE & CHIEF JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE AND MACT-XI, TUMAKURU, AWARDING COMPENSATION OF RS.16,946/- WITH PROPORTIONATE COST AND FUTURE INTEREST AT THE RATE OF 6% PER ANNUM FROM THE DATE OF THE PETITION TILL REALIZATION OF ENTIRE AMOUNT.

JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:

The learned counsel for the appellant has filed a memo dated 07.08.2024 seeking leave of this Court to withdraw the appeal.
2. The memo is placed on record.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
4. Registry is directed to refund the amount in deposit in favour of the appellant after due verification.
